columns.name: AlertTime
columns.description: Time (UTC) FullHunt raised the alert, from the API timestamp field

columns.name: AlertId
columns.description: FullHunt alert ID. Unique per alert; use it to deduplicate

columns.name: AlertType
columns.description: Alert type, e.g. new_subdomain_discovered, network_ports_discovered, vulnerability_discovered

columns.name: IsSeen
columns.description: True if the alert was marked as seen in FullHunt
